name: prompt-composer
title: Prompt Composer
description: The box where people write to an AI: a growing text area, pill controls for attachments and modes, and a send button, edged with a glow in the brand's colours.

examples.name: prompt-composer-demo
examples.title: Prompt Composer
examples.description: The spectrum glow on glass. Type and press Enter: send turns into stop and the glow breathes while the reply is written. Follows the brand's language.

examples.name: prompt-composer-brand-glow
examples.title: Brand glow
examples.description: glow="brand": the edge and halo in the brand's primary and accent colours, on a solid face.

examples.name: prompt-composer-plain
examples.title: No glow
examples.description: glow={false} for a quiet composer: the same keyboard behaviour without the light.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed text on Enter or the send button. Shift+Enter adds a line.

props.name: isPending
props.description: A reply is being written: the send button becomes stop and the glow breathes.

props.name: startActions
props.description: Toolbar controls at the start: attach, pickers.

props.name: endActions
props.description: Toolbar controls before the send button.

props.name: glow
props.description: The two-colour edge and halo. brand: primary and accent. spectrum: warning to info, warm to cool, the same in every brand's palette. false turns it off.

props.name: surface
props.description: glass is a frosted face for a composer floating over content; text keeps 4.5:1 over any backdrop.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the text box.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. With no children the pill becomes a circle and needs aria-label.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being chosen. Read together with the choice, e.g. "Reasoning: DeepThink".

props.name: options
props.description: { id, label, icon?, description? } for each choice.

keyboard.action: Sends. Does nothing while an input method is still composing a word.
Moves from the text box through the toolbar controls to send.

notes: The send button is disabled while the box is empty, and becomes a Stop button while a reply is pending.
Focus in the text box draws the 2px focus ring around the whole composer; the brighter glow is decoration.
The glow colours swap sides and the send arrow mirrors on right-to-left pages.
On narrow composers pills with an icon show only the icon; the label stays as visually hidden text, so the name is unchanged.

do: Keep the toolbar to a few controls; put the rest in the attach menu.
dont: Don't use the glow on more than one element in a view.
